title: A handover that survives the chat

source.angle: A useful AI-work handover states the changes, checks and remaining decisions rather than depending on a chat summary.

intent.audience: Founders and engineering teams handing over AI-assisted work
intent.objective: Identify handover problems and direct relevant readers to the product overview
intent.cta: Describe which answer is missing from an AI handover

assistance.disclosure: New buyer-problem framing from existing public product boundaries, not a new engineering milestone. post-once only distributes it.

claim_boundary: No universal audit coverage, new release, verified customer outcome or released AgentProof capability is claimed. Founder LinkedIn is not the company page.
